component.name: AquasuiteLinux
component.summary: Monitor Aquacomputer devices and control fans with curves, Delta T and alarms

description.p: A native Linux app for Aquacomputer water cooling devices: QUADRO, OCTO, D5 NEXT, aquaero, farbwerk, high flow NEXT, LEAKSHIELD and aquastream. It shows every sensor, builds virtual sensors such as Delta T (coolant above ambient), runs fan curves and other controllers on the device or in software, raises alarms, switches profiles and imports the fan curves aquasuite stored on your devices.
AquasuiteLinux is an independent project and is not affiliated with Aqua Computer.
